title: Thursday Daily Practice
subtitle: News words review and Overview + Body 1 for a table about newspaper readers
source: Daily Practice Week 5 và Weekly Quiz Week 5 (print/W5/src), đáp án theo bản Key của thầy.
intro: Làm lần lượt các bước, khoảng 15 phút. Từ vựng hôm nay: 5 từ mới + 10 từ ôn. Hạn nộp 00:00 đêm cùng ngày. Đủ và đúng hạn được 20 Meow, muộn hoặc làm một nửa được 10 Meow. Đừng xem đáp án trước khi làm xong.

steps.title: Step 1 · Vocab Quest Part A (4 min)
steps.instructions: Fill each gap with one phrase from the box, in the correct form. Use each phrase once. Box: a combination of · press coverage · subscription · motivation · headline · surge · keep up to date with · current affairs

items.label: 1. She wrote a clear ______ for the story.
2. I use an app to ______ the news.
items.explain: keep up to date with = cập nhật tin tức.

items.label: 3. Politics and economics are part of ______.
4. I pay a monthly ______ to read the paper online.
5. The festival got a lot of ______ in local papers.
items.explain: press coverage = độ phủ truyền thông.

items.label: 6. Money was not her ______; she wanted to help people.
7. Online news ______ after 2010, while print news plummeted.
8. Most readers use ______ phones and laptops.
items.explain: a combination of = sự kết hợp của.

steps.title: Step 2 · Vocab Quest Part B (2 min)

options.A: to be shared very quickly by many people
options.B: an increase that is slow and regular

options.D: an increase that is slow and regular

steps.title: Step 3 · Overview + Body 1 (9 min)
steps.instructions: Look at the table: millions of newspaper readers in Brazil, Poland and Kenya. (a) Write the Overview in 2 sentences (3 min): the main trend and one difference. No numbers. (b) Write Body 1 for Brazil and Poland (6 min). Use a topic sentence, start, change, end and one comparison. Support: Overall, the number of newspaper readers ______ in Brazil and Poland, whereas ______ was the only country to ______.

images.alt: Table: millions of newspaper readers in Brazil, Poland and Kenya in 2000, 2010 and 2020

open.model: Overall, the number of newspaper readers fell in Brazil and Poland, whereas Kenya was the only country to see an increase. Brazil had the most readers in the first two years, but Kenya had the most in 2020.

ai.task: The table shows millions of newspaper readers in Brazil (12, 9, 5), Poland (6, 6, 5) and Kenya (2, 3, 6) in 2000, 2010 and 2020. Write the Overview in 2 sentences: the main trend and one difference. No numbers.
criteria: bắt đầu bằng Overall và có xu hướng chính
có một sự khác biệt (cao nhất hoặc nước duy nhất tăng)
ngữ pháp và chính tả đúng

open.model: Brazil had the largest readership at 12 million in 2000, but this fell steadily to 9 million in 2010 and 5 million in 2020. Poland's figure stood at 6 million in the first two years before dipping slightly to 5 million in 2020, so it ended level with Brazil.

ai.task: The table shows millions of newspaper readers in Brazil (12, 9, 5) and Poland (6, 6, 5) in 2000, 2010 and 2020. Write Body 1 for Brazil and Poland.
criteria: có số liệu điểm đầu, thay đổi và điểm cuối
có một câu so sánh giữa hai nước
dùng từ chỉ xu hướng đúng (fell steadily, stood at, dipped)
ngữ pháp và chính tả đúng
